meta.title: Part Q: one-loop two-body kernels of Q_1 (Sigma), S_1 (Sigma^*), K_1 (K_b); final after revision

engines.A: step2/composite_qsk/qsk/engine_a (route A, exact simplex integrals; rerun end to end after the revision)
engines.B: step2/composite_qsk/qsk/engine_b (route B, momentum space, Feynman parameters, eps-extrapolation; T5 placement fixed)

meta.units: u = hbar tr_g(ad_X ad_Y)/(16 pi^2 (X,Y)) = -g^2 N/(32 pi^2); stripped engine values in hbar/(16 pi^2) times colour words C_w = (1 (x) ad_{Y_w1}..ad_{Y_wr})(-,-)^{-1}; on a colour-singlet pair with two outputs the stripped value is the coefficient in units u
meta.regulator: Schwinger cutoff t >= eps on every edge P(eps,T), special edge K_eps - K_0 with t in [0,eps]; T = infinity along Sigma, Sigma^* (Prop c8-Tsafe), finite T along K_b (Def c8-K); no dimensional regularisation in any role; no other IR regulator
meta.numbers: exact, Q(i) (x) {1, log2, log3, log5, log7}; L := log(3/2)

status: Kernels computed and cross-checked by two routes: E0, TQ0 (Sigma, Sigma^*), TQ2 (n = 0 all pairs; n = 1..3 route A), TQ3 twist pair entries at arity one (n <= 1), TQ4 scalar bilinears with the cocycle scheme, G-R1, intrinsic parts along eta and K_b, G-reg, G-KT along K_b. Open: TQ1 (action side), finite special vertices on route-A rows with D >= 2, Upsilon_xixi, relations R2-R6, the class-level twist comparison, TQ8.

conventions.arrows: xi.: lambda -> +Gamma(xi,lambda) (slot A), A -> +1/2 rho(dA) xi (slot lambda), A^* -> lambda^*, lambda^* -> A^* (pairing); Lemma qs-arrows as revised (the first print had the opposite overall sign)
conventions.classical_component: {S^(1)(xi), int omega (iota_w1 A, iota_w2 A)} = +F1 (Cor c7-Q)

sign_rule.route_A: on top of the raw chain and the pair sign (-1)^{|X_a|+|X_b|}: (-1)^{n(<sigma) + |S1(x)|(n(<s)+[s<sigma])} (-1)^{[sigma = edge at X_b]}, GLOBAL = +1
sign_rule.route_B: D_x = +(hbar/2) sum s_x STr[...], s_x = (-1)^{n(<sigma) + |S1(x)|(n(<s)+[s<sigma])}, times the reordering sign of the odd outputs
sign_rule.fixed_by: G-reg (Delta, P_b), G-pole, graded symmetry X_a <-> X_b, G-R1

conventions.grassmann_bookkeeping: an engine value with ordered outputs is the coefficient of theta_1 theta_2 for chains visiting the outputs in that order; the functional coefficient in a fixed order is v(Y1,Y2) - v(Y2,Y1) for two odd outputs, v(Y1,Y2) + v(Y2,Y1) otherwise
conventions.orientation: dictionary orientation (S_+ = undotted for dx^1 dx^2 dx^3 dx^4); engine A internal labels are mirrored (A lam_+ = dictionary S_- (x) W^*); numbers identical by the reflection symmetry (verified in route B code); all reported two-component forms in the dictionary orientation
conventions.two_component: Def c8-twocomp, Rem qs-twocomp: sigma^m = (sigma^1,sigma^2,sigma^3,i), sigmabar^m = (-sigma^1,-sigma^2,-sigma^3,i), eps^{12} = eps^{1dot2dot} = +1; Gamma(xi,lambda)|_V^m = i(lambdabar_{alphadot i} sigmabar^{m alphadot alpha} xi_alpha^i + xibar_{alphadot i} sigmabar^{m alphadot alpha} lambda_alpha^i); iota_w A = 1/4 w^{ij} A_ij, (w1,w2) = 1/4 w1^{ij} w2_ij

proved_theory: Thm qs-classes: hbar L_1(O)^(1)(x) = sum_{a<b} (Koszul) int omega ... Upsilon_x(X_a,X_b) ... - {hbar F_1^(1)(x), O} for every local O, gauge-variant included; Upsilon_x = [eps^0] D_x + F_x, F_x = -sum_m ((-1)^m/m!)({I, ct1_{x,m}}_{H^m} + {S^(1)(x), ct_m}_{H^m})
pole identity eq qs-pole (with the vacuum-pole x spectator terms read pair by pair) and arity-one log covariance eq qs-logcov
Cor qs-exist: local representative through arity one exists given the QME through arity one along x

Prop qs-comm (revised): [xi.,Q] = [xi.,H] = 0; C_xi = [xi.,Q^GF]: lambda_- -> c (+i(p,Gamma(xi,lambda)|_V)), A^*|_V -> lambda_+ ((p,A^*|_V) xi), lambda^*_+ -> A|_V, c^* -> lambda^*_- (xi in S_+ (x) W); eta. = sum x^mu xi_mu. + eta^0. + Y_eta; [eta.,H] = 2 xi_mu. d_mu; [v.,Q^GF] = 4(b,x) Q^GF + C_K, C_K A_V = -4(b,A_V)

Cor qs-edges: V_xi = (C_xi g(H) (x) 1)K_0 in lambda (x) A|_V, c (x) lambda^*; composite line 2(P* xi. P* (x) 1)K_0 = -+2 xi e^{-2 eps p^2}/p^2 (real, negative on c (x) lambda_+); [Q, P* xi. P*] = E(H) C_xi g(H) != 0
Prop qs-ward (Ward identity of the flow along xi); Prop qs-posdec (position decomposition along eta, K_b); Prop qs-bound (output bounds)

Thm qs-simplex: 16 pi^2 a_0 = int_{alpha_sigma smallest} F_0 log(min_{f!=sigma} alpha_f/alpha_sigma), 16 pi^2 a_m = (1/m) int [(min alpha_f)^m - alpha_sigma^m] F_m, no log eps; T d_T = O(eps) along K_b
Prop qs-freexi (revised): closed quadratic directions span{S^V_2 = T1+T3, S^perp_2 = T2+T4} along Sigma; along Sigma^* {x.(T1+T3), x.(T2+T4) + s0}; no exact ones
Lemma qs-cocycle (new): with L_1^(0) = 0 on {O, F1} the gauge-variant and BRST coefficients of Q_1 on the trace bilinear vanish; R1 at psi = 0 is a3 + 2 kappa - kappa' = 0
Prop qs-laws, Thm qs-invariant (renormalisation freedom, invariant content); Prop qs-plane (chiral bilinears); Thm qs-twistcheck (what the twist comparison tests, under D in C S^xi + Im Q^xi_0)

composite_line_route_A.statement: L(k) S h_T1+..+T4(-k,k) S L(k)/2 (engine normalisation, numerators of P(eps,infty) with e^{-eps k^2}/k^2 each): components c x lam = -|k|^2 xi, lam x c = +|k|^2 xi; one orientation gives -+ xi e^{-2 eps |k|^2}/|k|^2 (-,-)^{-1}, and the composite line 2(P* xi. P* (x) 1)K_0 (both orientations) is -+ 2 xi e^{-2 eps |k|^2}/|k|^2 (-,-)^{-1}, negative on c (x) lam: real, as route B (the factor +-2i guessed in Rem qs-twocomp was wrong)

recorded.canonical_form: two-leg outputs on plane waves alpha delta + beta^mu d_mu delta + gamma^{mu nu} d_mu d_nu delta <-> int omega (x^mu x^nu K_munu + x^mu K_mu + K_0): K_0 = alpha, K_mu = i beta^mu, K_munu = -gamma^{munu}; route B computes position factors as -i d/dr (one) and -d^2/dr dr (two) of a momentum r injected at the S vertex and absorbed by omega
recorded.twisted_coefficient: Q^xi_1 = L_1^(0) + Q_1 - (1/2) L_1^(2)(xi,xi) (Def c8-twisted, Prop qs-twist (i)); used as stated
recorded.colour_T5: T5 = (1/4) sum_{MN} ([A_M,A_N], (rho_M rho_N xi, lam*)) carries the colour key f of vertices.py and acts on the cycle as ad_Y of its output Y, like a cubic vertex of I (Rem qs-colour)

E0.agreement: both routes: [xi.,Q] = [xi.,H] = 0; C_xi components restricted to V as stated; composite line real

TQ0.Sigma: Q-closed quadratic directions span{T1+T3, T2+T4} = span{S^V_2(xi), S^perp_2(xi)}; no exact direction (routes A and B)
TQ0.Sigma_star: span{x.(T1+T3), x.(T2+T4) + s0}: s0 is not an independent closed direction (route B)

closed_forms.simplex: 16 pi^2 [eps^0] = int_{alpha_sigma smallest} F_0 log(min_{f != sigma} alpha_f / alpha_sigma) dalpha; 16 pi^2 [eps^-m] = (1/m) int [(min_{f!=sigma} alpha_f)^m - alpha_sigma^m] F_m dalpha; no log eps
closed_forms.n_t=2: 16 pi^2 a_0 = int_0^{1/2} F_0(alpha) log((1-alpha)/alpha), 16 pi^2 a_m = (1/m) int_0^{1/2} ((1-alpha)^m - alpha^m) F_m: Q + Q log 2
closed_forms.constant_integrands: 16 pi^2 [eps^0] = F_0 log(n_t/(n_t-1))/(n_t-1)! for a constant F_0 (leg sets with D = 0, no pole); 16 pi^2 [eps^-1] = F_1/(n_t^2 (n_t-1)(n_t-1)!) for a constant F_1 (D = 2); exact for n_t = 2..6 (route B); e.g. n_t = 3: (1/2) log(3/2) and 1/36
closed_forms.cubic_example: k_I = 0 T5 cycle on (A_perp, lambda_+) with output A_perp at the special edge: 16 pi^2 x value = (-1/(2 eps) - (3/8)|q|^2) x factor; eps^0/eps^-1 = (3/4)|q|^2 (both routes, independent check)
closed_forms.D0_legsets: chain by chain rational multiples of log(3/2)/2 (n_t = 3) or log(4/3)/6 (n_t = 4) (route B)
closed_forms.n=2_line: Prop c11-k1 weights W_0(beta) = (1-beta) log((1-beta)/(2 beta)) - (1 - 3 beta) on beta in [0,1/3]: Q + Q log2 + Q log3

functionals.F1: int omega [(iota_w1 A, (rho(w2) xi, lambda)) + (1<->2)] = {S^(1)(xi), O}

psi_0_two_body.chiralities: identical for xi in S_+ (x) W and S_- (x) W^* (both routes)

c_Q.formula: Q_1(O)|_traceless = c_Q {S^(1)(xi), O},  c_Q = -2 L - theta_perp - p_perp  (units u)
c_Q.one_body: -theta_perp - p_perp: p_perp from the particular solution of eq qs-arity1xi (TQ1, open), theta_perp the free direction

scheme_family.cutoff shape: a combination of the above (Prop qs-laws (e))

cocycle_scheme.L1_at_psi0: L_1^(0)(O) = -(2 + 4 L) u (w1,w2) int omega (dc, A_V) (no c d.A_V part); two-field part of L_1^(0)(F1) = 2 u s F3
cocycle_scheme.statement: Q_1(O)|_two-body = -2 L F1 + 4 L F2 on the trace bilinear in a scheme with L_1^(0) = 0 on {O, F1}; the gauge-variant term drops out (Lemma qs-cocycle)

route_A.psi(O): -1 + 2*log2 + -2*log3 u (w1,w2) int omega (A_V, A_V)  [L_1^(0)(O) = 2 kappa u (w1,w2) int omega (dc, A_V) at psi = 0, removed]
route_A.psi(F1): -2 u F3  (two-field sector of L_1^(0)(F1) removed)
route_A.change of Q_1(O): [{S^(1)(xi),-}, psi](O) = 2 kappa F3 - kappa' F3  (Prop c8-laws (b))
route_A.statement: in a scheme with L_1^(0) = 0 on {O, F1} the two-body part of Q_1 on the trace bilinear is a1 F1 + a2 F2: the gauge-variant term drops out (a3 = 0), as required by s Q_1(O) = 0 (R1); a1, a2, a4 and the traceless part are unchanged

two_component.orientation: dictionary orientation (S_+ = undotted for dx^1 dx^2 dx^3 dx^4); engine A labels mirrored, numbers identical by the reflection symmetry
two_component.O: int omega (iota_w1 A, iota_w2 A) = 1/16 int omega (w1^{ij} A_ij, w2^{kl} A_kl)
two_component.F1: int omega [(iota_w1 A, (rho(w2) xi, lam)) + (1<->2)] = 1/4 int omega [(w1^{kl} A_kl, w2_{ji} xi^{alpha i} lam_alpha^j) + (1<->2)]
two_component.F2: (w1,w2) int omega (rho(A|_perp) xi, lam) = 1/4 w1^{ij} w2_ij int omega (A_{ji}, xi^{alpha i} lam_alpha^j)
two_component.F3: (w1,w2) int omega (rho(A|_V) xi, lam) = 1/4 w1^{ij} w2_ij int omega i (lambdabar_{alphadot i}, A_m sigmabar^{m alphadot alpha} xi_alpha^i)
two_component.F4: (w1,w2) int omega (c, (xi, lam^*)) = 1/4 w1^{ij} w2_ij int omega (c, xi_alpha^i lam^{*alpha}_i)
two_component.classical: {S^(1)(xi), O} = +F1  (A_ij -> +Gamma(xi,lam)_ij, Gamma_kl(xi, lam) = -2 eps_{jikl} (xi^j lam^i), dictionary entry Gamma; Cor c7-Q)
two_component.Q1_two_body_psi0: Q_1(O)|_two-body = (2*log2 + -2*log3) F1 + (-4*log2 + 4*log3) F2 + (-4*log2 + 4*log3) F3 + (0) F4  units u = -g^2 N/(32 pi^2)  (psi = 0)
two_component.c_Q: Q_1(O)|_traceless = c_Q {S^(1)(xi), O},  c_Q = 2*log2 + -2*log3 - theta_perp - p_perp
two_component.trace_psi0: Q_1(O)|_trace, two-body (psi = 0) = (-4*log2 + 4*log3) (1/4 w1^{ij} w2_ij) int omega [(A_ji, xi^{alpha i} lam_alpha^j) + i (lambdabar_{alphadot i}, A_m sigmabar^{m alphadot alpha} xi_alpha^i)]
two_component.Konishi: Q_1( int omega (u'^alpha lam_alpha^i, A_ij z^j) ) contains 0 x int omega (lambdabar_{alphadot i} z^i, lambdabar^{alphadot}_j z^j): c_K = 0 (psi = 0)
two_component.bc_lamstar: Q_1( int omega (c, u_alpha lam^{*alpha}_4) ) on lambdabar_{alphadot 4} lambdabar^{alphadot}_4: 0
two_component.betabeta: Q_1( int omega (u'^alpha lam_alpha^I, u'^beta lam_beta^J) ) on (lambdabar_{alphadot 4}, d^{alphadot} A_{K4}), K the complement of I, J: nonzero, holomorphic derivatives d_alphadot = u'^alpha sigma^m_{alpha alphadot} d_m only, the same coefficient for both colour orders (per unit weight-vector letters 2/3 on d^{alphadot} gamma^K lambdabar_{alphadot 4}, modulo the Q^xi_0-exact Dirac component)
two_component.bgamma: Q_1( int omega (u'^alpha F_mn (sigma^m sigmabar^n)_alpha^beta u'_beta, A_{I4}) ) on (lambdabar_{alphadot 4}, d^{alphadot} A_{I4}): nonzero, holomorphic derivatives only; modulo Im Q^xi_0 the two colour orders have unequal coefficients containing log(3/2) (engine weight-vector normalisation 64/3 - 128 log(3/2) and 32 + 64 log(3/2)); no reduction modulo total derivatives
two_component.eta_killing: eps_alpha^i(x) = -i x_m sigma^m_{alpha alphadot} etabar^{alphadot i},  epsbar_{alphadot i}(x) = i x_m eta^alpha_i sigma^m_{alpha alphadot}; intrinsic vertex s0 = (A^{kj} eps_{alpha beta} eta^beta_j, lam^{*alpha}_k) - (A_kj eps_{betadot alphadot} etabar^{alphadot j}, lambdabar^{*betadot k})
two_component.K_b: v^m = x^2 b^m - 2 (b.x) x^m; intrinsic z-polynomial vertex of Rem qs-twocomp with z = x - x_O
two_component.cocycle_scheme: psi(O) = (-1 + 2*log2 + -2*log3) u 1/4 w1^{ij} w2_ij int omega (A_m, A_m), psi(F1) = (-2) u F3; then Q_1(O)|_two-body = (2*log2 + -2*log3) F1 + (-4*log2 + 4*log3) F2: the term i (lambdabar_{alphadot i}, A_m sigmabar^{m alphadot alpha} xi_alpha^i) drops out

G_R1.relation: s Q_1(O) + L_1^(0)({S^(1)(xi),O}) + {S^(1)(xi), L_1^(0)(O)} = 0 (Cor c8-homotopy (i), psi = 0), two-field sector (c, lambda_-)
G_R1.terms: A = s(a3 F3) = -2 L k, B = L_1^(0)(F1) = -k, C = {S^(1)(xi), L_1^(0)(O)} = (1 + 2 L) k; sum 0, rational and log parts separately

route_A.bookkeeping: odd-odd outputs (c, lam) antisymmetrised, even-odd (c, A_V) symmetrised; {S^(1)(xi),O} = +F1; {S^(1)(xi),-} odd derivation, A_V -> +Gamma(xi,lam)|_V (qa_r1.py docstring)

TQ3_twist.setting: xi = u (x) z rank one (weight vector), twisted letters basis-free from Cartan weights; Lemma: Q^xi_1 = L_1^(0) + Q_1 - (1/2) L_1^(2)(xi,xi); entries at arity one, psi = 0
TQ3_twist.normalisation: engine weight-vector normalisation (route A); BK normalisation needs the transport map Phi of Thm qs-twistcheck (open)
TQ3_twist.reduction: modulo Im Q^xi_0 only: no antiholomorphic derivative occurs; the derivative on a dc output (holomorphic Dirac component) is dropped, exact up to antifield terms; total derivatives kept

entries.betagamma [BK (3.66)] (lambda_+, A_perp): 0 identically for every xi (both routes); c_K = 0 at psi = 0; scheme dependent: c_K -> c_K - kappa_B y
entries.betabeta [BK (3.67)] (lambda_+, lambda_+: per unit letters (2/3) d^alphadot gamma^K dc_alphadot + (1/3 - 2 L) (Dirac component, exact); K the complement of I, J (eps_IJK); both colour orders equal; route B: same eps_IJK structure, A code = B code at four momenta
entries.bgamma [BK (3.68)] (A_V with the self-du: colour order (gamma, dc): 64/3 - 128 L; order (dc, gamma): 32 + 64 L (coefficient of the derivative on gamma); Dirac components -64/3 - 128 L, -32/3 + 64 L; unequal orders, log(3/2) present
entries.beta b -> beta dc [BK (3.69)]: -(64/3) c_beta in one colour order, 0 in the other
entries.beta b -> gamma gamma [BK (3.69)]: (8/3)(c1h1 c2h0 - c1h0 c2h1) on (gamma^J, gamma^K): eps structure, both orders equal
entries.gamma gamma (twisted outputs): 0; G-plane: two-body part on the chiral bilinears exactly 0 (both routes)

TQ3_twist.comparison_with_BK: BK (3.64)-(3.69) have the form (1/2) f_ACD f_BCE d_alphadot X^D d^alphadot Y^E with equal colour words. At the level of individual entries (psi = 0, this regularisation) betagamma and bc(lambda^*) vanish, betabeta and beta b -> gamma gamma have the BK structure with equal words, bgamma and beta b -> beta dc have unequal words and (bgamma) log(3/2). Individual entries are scheme dependent (Rem qs-twistfreedom: F1 theta, F3 psi, field rescalings), so this is not a disagreement; the class-level test (Thm qs-twistcheck (d): relations [BK, (3.59)-(3.63)] through the tree-level psl(3|3) commutant, one-body terms, R_1/S_1 terms) is not done, and Thm qs-twistcheck holds only under the hypothesis D in C S^xi + Im Q^xi_0 (not derived)

route_A.eta_chirality: S_+ (x) W^* (generators S^alpha_i); xi_mu = rho(e_mu) eta in S_- (x) W^*
route_A.position_part: graph by graph the xi-kernel at rho(b) eta (built so; G-pos)
route_A.S_1_on_bilinears: S_1(O) = Q_1 along the Killing spinor rho(x_O) eta (position part, coefficients of TQ4 along S_- (x) W^*) + Upsilon^0_eta, whose only leg set on (A_perp, A_perp) is a single lam, which vanishes on the colour-singlet bilinear; the one-body s0 direction does not act on A_perp letters. Hence Upsilon^0_eta = 0 on O (Cor c7-S).
route_A.S_1_on_descendants: Upsilon^0_eta(A_perp, lam_+) on the leg set A_perp A_perp (rows above) gives the intrinsic part of S_1 on the weight-5/2 descendants

TQ5_eta.route_B: intrinsic parts on 5 pairs, agree with route A on 4/4 compared rows; (A_perp, lambda_+) -> A_perp A_perp exceeded the memory cap
TQ5_eta.S_1_on_bilinears: S_1(O) = Q_1 along the Killing spinor rho(x_O) eta (position part); Upsilon^0_eta(A_perp, A_perp) has the single leg set lambda, zero on the colour singlet

route_A.K_1_on_bilinears: Upsilon^0_K(A_perp,A_perp) has the leg sets (none) and A_V only (weight 1): zero on the colour-singlet bilinear, so K_1(O) = v(x)^mu P_1(O)|_{e_mu} - (b,x) D^0_1(O) + M^0_1(O) by eq qs-K1dec (G-KD with P_1 ~ 0, M^0_1 = 0 by covariance on scalars)
route_A.T_independence: route A evaluates the T-independent eps -> 0 coefficients of Thm qs-simplex (iii), (iv) directly; the log T term (3/8 pi^2) hbar x zero-mode tree is not part of K_1 (Prop qs-K (ii)) and is not computed by route A

bilinears.reading: Upsilon^0_Delta = 40/3 O (traceless) and 40/3 - 48 = -104/3 per unit trace bilinear; with the position part 2 x^mu (-1/3) d_mu O this is the first row of Thm c9-D1: 44/3 O - 1/3 {S^(1)(Delta),O} (traceless), -100/3 O - 1/3 {S^(1)(Delta),O} (trace); Upsilon_{P_b} = -1/3 d_b O (Thm c9-P1)
